source.publication: 2025 SC1040 Individual Income Tax Instructions (SCDOR) and the 2025 SC1040 form and tax tables (IITPacket_2025)
source.section: Plain wage return, no subtractions; SC1040 lines 1-6 and 15 (packet PDF pp.46-47); Instructions PDF p.5 Line 1 (federal taxable income); Instructions PDF p.16 Line 6; Tax Rate Schedule packet PDF p.51 (6% minus 642, any filing status); brackets as derived in the record (brackets.derivation)

worked: Federal AGI = wages 60,000.00 = 60,000.00. Federal taxable income = 60,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 (15,750.00 single) = 44,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored, federal figures given, not tested). SC1040 line 1 federal taxable income 44,250.00; additions lines a-e none, line 2 = 0.00; line 3 = 44,250.00. Subtractions lines f-w none; line 4 = 0.00. Line 5 South Carolina income subject to tax = 44,250.00 - 0.00 = 44,250.00. Line 6 tax = 3% x (17,840.00 - 3,560.00) + 6% x (44,250.00 - 17,840.00) = 428.40 + 1,584.60 = 2,013.00 (same as 6% x 44,250.00 - 642 = 2,655.00 - 642.00 = 2,013.00); the printed table (row 44,200 to 44,300, figured at the row midpoint) gives 2,013; expected uses the bracket formula on the exact income. Line 12 Two Wage Earner Credit: not modelled (warning), 0.00; it is for joint filers only, so 0 anyway. Line 14 credits 0.00; line 15 state income tax = 2,013.00.
accepted_approximations: The bracket starts 3,560 and 17,840 are derived from the printed tax table and the 6%-minus-642 formula; the table fixes them only to 3,559-3,566 and 17,818-17,857. Tax below 100,000 is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses the table row's midpoint.
